datasets.label: Google cluster trace samples (BTW 2023)
datasets.description: Three preprocessed event-trace samples derived from the Google cluster traces and shipped with the prototype as datasets/google_query1.txt.gz, google_query2.txt.gz and google_query3.txt.gz. Each line is one trace of whitespace-separated event types; the testbench converts them to multidimensional samples (558, 679 and 84 traces) before discovery.
datasets.access_statement: Included in the public prototype repository.
